state_tiers.implemented: Source module exists and is reachable through the API/dashboard.
state_tiers.unit_tested: Deterministic unit tests cover the critical transformations and edge cases.
state_tiers.integration_tested: API/engine/router tests exercise the feature end to end with mocked external services.
state_tiers.live_e2e_tested: A recorded live end-to-end run against real services was executed and persisted.
state_tiers.externally_benchmarked: A persisted benchmark compares output against an external reference/ground truth.
state_tiers.validated: A predeclared acceptance rule was met against externally defensible ground truth.
state_tiers.regression_gated: The benchmark is mandatory in CI and blocks release on failure.

release_gate: A feature may enter the publication evidence set only for tiers it has actually attained. The strongest attained tier governs permitted claim wording. Nothing may be described as 'validated' unless the validated tier is present, and no result is regression-gated unless the regression_gated tier is present. No UI, manuscript, README, or export may translate a lower tier into a higher one.
claims_ledger: publication/claims.csv must not contain any claim whose required tiers exceed the tiers recorded here.

features.name: BLAST sequence search (EBI/NCBI)
features.external_ground_truth: Configured EMBL-EBI/NCBI endpoint with identical program/database settings; database release frozen where possible.
features.notes: Multi-query accession-recovery benchmark added 2026-09-06 (8 curated queries, 2 essential, recovery in top-5 hits, threshold 0.8). Live harness run records PASS (7/8 queries, 0.875>=0.8; both essentials recovered) though EBI is flaky — transient Status=ERROR/ReadTimeout needed retries; infra finding: BlastTool._fetch_results 30s read timeout + EBI ETA variability. HUMAN_ACTB miss is a tie-ordering artifact, not a capability failure: top-5 hits are 100%-identical orthologs (P60707 possum, P60711 rat, P60713 sheep, Q4L0Y2 squirrel, Q5R6G0 orangutan). 2026-09-07 production finding + fix: the default protein database 'nr' maps to EBI uniprotkb, which exceeded the 180s poll budget, and NCBI's queue RTOE was 62192s (>90s threshold) — so default BLAST was a guaranteed timeout. Default changed to Swiss-Prot (blast_config DEFAULT_DATABASE) and _run_ebi_blast_fallback now degrades any failed comprehensive-DB search to uniprotkb_swissprot (recorded as _degraded_from) instead of failing. Live check with a 606-aa carotenoid-dioxygenase query (previously failing): 18.1s, 70 hits, top Q8LP17 e=4.8e-69. Persistent result snapshots live in benchmark/results/ (gitignored); SEQ-BLAST is regression-tested and harness-gated, and is only externally_benchmarked when a stable persisted pass record exists.
